_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the Team Manager Discord bot. Pulls the latest code from GitHub and installs dependencies on every server start.
name: Team Manager Bot
author: brantshaw4@gmail.com
description: Team Manager Discord bot (discord.js). On every start it fetches the configured branch from GitHub, hard-resets to it, runs npm install, then launches the bot. Your src/.env is git-ignored, so updates never touch it.
startup: if [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]] && [[ -d .git ]]; then echo "[updater] Fetching {{GIT_BRANCH}}..."; if [[ -n "{{ACCESS_TOKEN}}" ]]; then git remote set-url origin "https://{{USERNAME}}:{{ACCESS_TOKEN}}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}"; else git remote set-url origin "{{GIT_ADDRESS}}"; fi; if git fetch --depth 1 origin "{{GIT_BRANCH}}"; then git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD && echo "[updater] Now on $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"; else echo "[updater] Fetch failed, starting current version"; fi; fi; if [[ -f package.json ]]; then npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; node {{MAIN_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Team Manager install script - runs once on server install/reinstall
apt update
apt install -y git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
    REPO_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}"
else
    REPO_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
    echo "Existing repo found, updating"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO_URL}"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
    # keep a pre-existing src/.env if the server is being reinstalled
    [[ -f src/.env ]] && cp src/.env /tmp/team-manager.env
    find . -mindepth 1 -delete
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${REPO_URL}" .
    [[ -f /tmp/team-manager.env ]] && cp /tmp/team-manager.env src/.env
fi

if [[ ! -f src/.env ]]; then
    printf 'TOKEN=\nCLIENT_ID=\nTEST_SERVER_ID=\nDB_HOST=\nDB_USER=\nDB_PASS=\nDB_NAME=\nTIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=\nTIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET=\nTIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=\n' > src/.env
    echo "Created empty src/.env - fill it in from the file manager before starting"
fi

npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
echo "Install complete"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the bot's GitHub repository.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = pull the latest code from the branch on every start/restart. 0 = keep the current code.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: GitHub username. Only needed if the repository is private.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: GitHub fine-grained personal access token with read-only Contents access. Only needed if the repository is private.
